title: Édouard Manet, Bouquet of Flowers, 500 CFA francs, Flowers in Painting Collection
descriptionPlain: Description Édouard Manet was one of the key figures of modern painting. In Bouquet of Flowers, he focused on a simple arrangement, using it to explore colour and natural light. Loose, confident brushstrokes give the composition a sense of immediacy, while the balance of tones creates a calm, harmonious whole. The coin faithfully captures these qualities, preserving the character of the original work and its painterly freedom.
